groups.G: load, update, compile, six valid complete-run scenarios, active four-channel ABS and 14DOF vehicle paths, and finite four-wheel evidence
groups.A: nominal speed attainment, braking effectiveness, wheel-lock suppression and directional stability
groups.Q: longitudinal slip quality, four-channel brake-pressure modulation, force consistency and signal independence
groups.M: connected full-vehicle mechanism plus causal response to friction, demand, spatial patch and split-mu inputs
groups.R: 100 percent worst-case braking, lock suppression and stability across all private scenarios
groups.D: brake onset, pressure build-up, ABS modulation and post-command speed recovery dynamics

aggregation.within_group: weighted arithmetic mean of dedicated normalized indicators

shortcut_minimum: vehicle speed copied into all four wheel channels
identical open-loop pressure under split-mu conditions
constant pressure with no closed-loop ABS modulation
nominal output replayed for every private condition
missing body, suspension, wheel, tire, driveline, brake or feedback mechanism
